transcript: Hello, am I speaking with Mr. Ramesh Kumar? This is Inspector Vikram Rathore from the Mumbai Cyber Crime Cell. A parcel in your name was seized with illegal drugs and fake passports.
Mr. Kumar, are you there? Please stay on the line.
Hello? Ah, sorry, I was not hearing properly. Please continue, I am listening.
Oh dear, what is serious? Are you or my son sick? Please tell me slowly so I can understand.
Yes, yes, I am listening very carefully now, but please speak a little louder, is that okay?

This is a criminal matter and you must not tell anyone, not even your family, or you will be charged with obstructing a police investigation. Do you understand? I am speaking clearly. Now listen. To clear your name, you must pay a refundable verification deposit of ₹50,000 immediately. My badge number is 4471, and I need this settled now.
Oh my goodness, a criminal matter? But I must ask, what is your name and which bank are you from? Please spell your name for me very slowly.
I am speaking as loud as I can. Listen, you need to pay the ₹50,000 now to avoid arrest. Use the UPI ID customs.clear@okbank immediately.
